ndtw_backend: exact Euclidean DTW, official FDTW=False semantics
model_loads: one per session; same process for each complete pair
order: Frozen manifest: collection and unseen house blocks, DEV inherits V5; balanced AB/BA within every evaluation pair
stop_and_success: Unchanged V3: active STOP with geodesic distance <3m, all decisions including STOP/recovery count to500
old_numeric_failure: Preserved. New cache reconstruction and three fixed FIT live diagnostics; do not rerun 5487 native replays.
completion: One CPU fit + deterministic calibration -> calibration sanity -> DEV100 -> prior SR/SPL gate -> at most one public unseen1839 -> stop
change: Fit the fixed V18 terminal objective on32 FIT houses; analytically calibrate STOP bias on8 reserved calibration houses to not exceed V13 observed per-trajectory false-STOP rate. No refit on calibration houses.
loss: mean_house(mean_trajectory(softplus(logmeanexp(unique out-of-range negative margins)) + BCE(actual successful terminal STOP margin,1))) + .001/2 residual L2
normalization: equal house then physical trajectory; negative log-mean-exp includes count normalization; one actually executed legal terminal STOP positive; anchor and scale unchanged
probe_split: 32 fit/8 calibration; calibration is selection data, not an independent test

recovery.reason: Existing64 collected and audited separately; excluded to isolate this repair from more data.

unseen_gate: DEV B_sr>A_sr and B_spl>=A_spl; failed gate is complete development evaluation, not invalid
training_data: same640 trajectories and37645 canonical features; negatives are observed distance>=3 states; only physically executed successful terminal STOP is positive; other in-range states ignored, never negative
goal: engineering recovery of early STOP regressions; no architecture/numerical/metric changes
fit_sanity: calibration terminal recall >= .9*reference; calibration per-trajectory false STOP <=reference; no subsequent weight/threshold search
calibration: Weighted order statistic of each calibration-trajectory max negative STOP margin; reference risk budget from V13 on same calibration histories; fixed1e-5 numerical tie reserve; no grid search or DEV/UNSEEN reads.
